title: Wigglytuff EX Japanese 040/165 Pokemon 151 Card RR Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Japanese Wigglytuff EX Pokémon card is a must-have for any collector. With a rarity of Double Rare and a card number of 040/165, it's sure to be a valuable addition to your collection. The card features artwork by Saki Hayashiro and has a holographic finish.

The card is a Standard size and made from card stock material. It's perfect for fans of the Pokémon Trading Card Game, with Wigglytuff as the creature type and Ancient Animal as the monster type. The card is suitable for ages 4 and up and was manufactured by Nintendo in 2023. Don't miss out on the chance to add this card to your collection!
